component.name: DirDuo
component.summary: SteamOS-first dual-display file manager for Linux

description.p: DirDuo is a file manager in the spirit of the classic dual-display file managers: two lists side by side or one above the other, one the source and the other the destination, and every command works from one to the other. It is made for the Steam Deck in Desktop Mode as much as for a desktop PC, with touch-friendly sizes, pinch to zoom and SD card support.

ul.li: Source and destination displays with tabs, folder trees, flat view, grouping and a filter bar
File operations in their own windows with pause, queues per drive, Retry/Skip and undo
Toolbars you build yourself: three-button buttons, split buttons, menus and fields, between the displays or at the edges
A standalone viewer for pictures, music, video, PDFs, text and archives, with a slideshow and marking
Index Search: any file by name, instantly, across home and cards
Archives as folders, extract and create zip, 7z and tar; servers over SFTP, FTP, SMB and WebDAV
Music and photo columns, labels, ratings and tags, checksums, Synchronize, Find Duplicates and Advanced Rename
Your own keys, right-click commands, tab groups, saved filters, status bar and JavaScript scripts
Add Windows programs and AppImages to Steam from the right-click menu

screenshot.caption: Two displays with folder trees, the toolbar between them, music tags in columns
Displays on top of each other with the classic toolbar arrangement
The standalone viewer: pictures, music, video, PDFs and more
Index Search: every file and folder by name as you type
Synchronize two folders, such as ROMs on internal storage and the SD card
Every key in one place, with hotkeys of your own

description.p: First test release, for the Steam Deck, Steam Frame and Linux desktops.

ul.li: Two displays, stacked or side by side, with toolbars between them
Queued copy and move jobs per drive, sync, compare, archives as folders
Index Search, a standalone viewer for pictures, music, video and PDFs
Thumbnails of pictures, videos, PDFs, album art and folders, with a live size slider
Double-clicked programs and AppImages run; scripts can run in a terminal

description.p: Phase 1: listers, dual displays, tabs, breadcrumbs, inline rename, aliases and the queued job manager.
